It reads whatever actually made it to disk via `AVAudioFile` (matching the writer side of the pipeline, not the deprecated `AVAsset.duration`), sets an honest recovered duration, flips status to `.recoveredAfterUnexpectedExit`, and saves. Deliberately fetches all entries and filters in-memory rather than using `#Predicate` on the enum — SwiftData's predicate macro is unreliable comparing custom Codable enums, and at this data scale (hundreds–low thousands) that's a non-issue.
